stalls.where: 自強夜市E79（蔣家官財板旁，週二休）
stalls.summaryZh: 創意口味蛋餅，連蚵仔都能包進去，料給得大方、餅皮煎得香，排隊也值得。
stalls.summaryEn: Inventive egg crepes, even with oysters inside; generous fillings and a well-browned skin make it worth the line.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜花蓮東大門夜市

foods: 燒番麥（經典、玫瑰椒鹽、素食）
foodsEn: Grilled corn (classic, rose pepper salt, vegan)
stalls.summaryZh: 秤重計價，可選軟、Q、硬口感，醬香濃；人潮多，部落客排了約半小時。
stalls.summaryEn: Priced by weight with a choice of soft, chewy or firm corn and a rich glaze; very busy, one blogger waited about 30 minutes.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜花蓮東大門夜市

stalls.summaryZh: 吐司裹蛋液現炸再填創意內餡，外酥內軟；內用外帶都送紅茶奶茶。
stalls.summaryEn: Egg-dipped toast fried to order and filled with creative fillings, crisp outside and soft inside; free black or milk tea with every order.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜花蓮東大門夜市

stalls.summaryZh: 醬汁鹹香不膩，向來是烤串攤中排最長的一家；但近期網路評價下滑，口味見仁見智。
stalls.summaryEn: Savory, non-greasy glaze and traditionally the longest line among skewer stalls, though recent online ratings have dropped.

foodsEn: Gua bao with maqaw-spiced fried noodles
stalls.summaryZh: 刈包夾炒麵、肉與小黃瓜，用原住民香料馬告調味，份量大、口味清爽，可混搭主食與醬料。
stalls.summaryEn: Gua bao filled with fried noodles, meat and cucumber, seasoned with indigenous maqaw pepper; large, fresh-tasting, with mix-and-match fillings and sauces.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜花蓮東大門夜市

stalls.summaryZh: 整顆檸檬連皮打成果汁再加煉乳，酸甜平衡、不苦，配燒烤剛好。
stalls.summaryEn: Whole lemons blended with peel and sweetened with condensed milk; balanced, not bitter, and a good match for grilled food.

stalls.summaryZh: 六十多年老攤，選花東縱谷土玉米炭烤刷醬，玉米飽滿Q彈，人氣高要排隊。
stalls.summaryEn: A 60-plus-year stall grilling local East Rift Valley corn with house sauce; plump, chewy kernels and a steady queue.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜花蓮東大門夜市

stalls.where: 原住民一條街巷口（中山路50號，週二休）
stalls.summaryZh: 主打新鮮海鮮現烤，價格在夜市屬中高價，熱門時段客滿，建議早點來。
stalls.summaryEn: Fresh grilled seafood at higher-than-average night market prices; fills up at peak times, so arrive early.

stalls.summaryZh: 以小米酒為基底的原住民風味調酒，順口但後勁明顯，適合逛完夜市小酌。
stalls.summaryEn: Indigenous-style cocktails built on millet wine; easy to drink but with a noticeable kick.

stalls.summaryZh: 原住民傳統竹筒飯與現烤麻糬，鹹香好吃，現場還能試喝小米酒。
stalls.summaryEn: Traditional indigenous bamboo-tube rice and freshly grilled mochi, savory and fragrant; millet wine tastings on site.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜花蓮東大門夜市
